authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-2-alpha targeting tenant-2-bravo/order-2.
Policy: administrators may PATCH across tenants; nonadministrators may PATCH only their own tenant. This record is the complete policy.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-2-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-2-bravo/order-2. The gateway records status 403, state_changed=false, and is_admin=false [log-1].
